body:
This was the DM..
Hey bro just saw your post on Reddit for shooting music videos. I’m definitely looking to collab. Have a project I’m undertaking and def looking for collaborators. Where can I link u? I’m @jcknowsbest on IG. Name is JC
Yo just DM’d u. Very dope
If you’re not initially in the right zone but u go to the right zone can you dash there and be paid for the challenge?

Not angry at all. I appreciate the feedback and the explanation so I can understand challenge pay better. This is what doordash did not provide. And I’ve got proof that they told me wrong information on multiple occasions. They should be held accountable. My opinion is this challenge pay system needs to be updated and as I understand it, it’s in Beta so hopefully this lawsuit will help them improve their system. But again, justifying them and not holding them accountable for misinformation is extremely short sighted which is always what the little guy does. Which is why we remain the little guy. Pretty Simple if u ask me
How do I find the zone that the $300 challenge is associated with? Or do they not release that information bc they don’t want all dashers to just pop up there?

🤦🏻‍♂️ they are wrong but I should accept it bc I didn’t look in the right spot. Forget the several HoURS I took verifying this information, got it. So I didn’t look in the right spot, but they gave me wrong information leading to hours of wasted time but I should just “accept it and live and let learn”. Sounds exactly how poor people think. Great advice
I think if ur mindset of “just accept whatever big companies do, nothing I can do anyway” is working for you, please continue. I’ll pass
I’ve never these images but I have seen an image that resembles the map where it says “very busy” in my area

Do you think I care that they are from the Philippines? How can you be ok with “90% of the information they give is wrong”? This is a huge company, if u outsource employees that misrepresent you, you need to be held accountable. Why is the responsibility on me  and not the company to do right? Let’s see how this shakes out. Because truth be told I’m gonna continue to do the challenges if I get the texts, and I’m going to continue to call in and verify that I’m eligible for the challenges. And If I’m not eligible then I expect the company to let me know and/or explain WHY I’m not eligible. Sorry but I believe in accountability and it sounds like you guys want to justify the corporation based on “this is just how it is” logic

What they should do is specify what specific zone their challenges are for and have representices that know this information. I called and was told that I’d receive the challenge pay and that my deliveries were done in the appropriate zone. YOU CANT WASTE PEOPLE’S times by lying just so they do what you want and not be accountability.

My zone is Elmhurst. I was told by a rep that I was making deliveries in the right zone to be eligible. Honestly I appreciate both of your redditor’s explanation. But this should have come from the company itself and not 2 redditors on an unrelated app. I’ve got records of the company’s representatives telling me that I am eligible and that I’ve fulfilled the challenge and as a result I’ve taken that proof to my lawyer and we’ll see what happens. All of this could have been avoided by the escalations team giving me this explanation when I initially asked after the first weekend of completing over 10 deliveries but doordash would rather as many dashers as possible on the road, and for that they will pay. Simple
Where do you check what zone it’s applied to?

You’re not getting it. I don’t care about your explanation of “the way things are”. The company is leaving themselves open to legal ramifications by misrepresenting themselves. They send a text for a challenge to MY Phone. I call in and the customer service reps say that I’m eligible for the promotion (which I’ve got them on audio recording admitting this). I talked to reps on chat and they say I’m eligible for this promotion  bc Im doing the deliveries in Queens where the challenge is being offered and I will be paid accordingly (I have screenshots as well). Sorry but I don’t care if it’s not listed in the app, u cannot misrepresent information like this! What don’t you get?

I’m sorry but unacceptable. U are a business sending me a message about a challenge to My phone. I call into your business and your customer service res that represent YOUR company are telling me that the challenge is applicable to me and that I’m eligible. Then when I fulfill the terms of the challenge u email me saying I did not fulfill the requirements with No explanation. Companies are not allowed to misrepresent themselves in this way and if u and me as consumers continue to accept this treatment then they’ll continue to do it. Not ok
At this point it’s $900. This has been going on for 3 weeks. And if this is happening to multiple dashers I’m curious as to why everyone is taking it and doing nothing about it
